THE TEACHER AI TOOLKIT
300 copy-paste prompts and 12 multi-step workflows

--------------------------------------------------------------------
WHICH FILE DO I OPEN?
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Working at your desk, about to use a prompt?
  ->  "Teacher AI Toolkit - COMPLETE.html"
      Opens in any browser. Every prompt has a Copy button.
      This is the one to use day to day.

Want just one chapter, or want to print?
  ->  PDF/  folder. One file per chapter, one prompt per page.

Want the whole book as a single PDF?
  ->  "Teacher AI Toolkit - COMPLETE.pdf"   (362 pages)

Want one chapter in the browser?
  ->  "Web (with Copy button)/"  folder.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
HOW TO USE A PROMPT
--------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Open 00-index to find what you need - all 312 entries are listed
   by name, by grade band and by subject.
2. Copy everything inside the prompt box.
3. Paste it into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.
4. Replace anything in [SQUARE BRACKETS] with your real details.
5. Read what comes back before anyone else does.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
BEFORE YOU START
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Read 00-safety once. It applies to every prompt in the book.

The short version: never paste a student's name, ID or any
identifying detail into an AI tool. Everything these prompts produce
is a first draft - you read it before it reaches a student, a family
or a permanent record.

--------------------------------------------------------------------

A PDF cannot carry a working copy button - the format allows it, but
no browser or phone viewer runs it. That is why the HTML version
exists, and why it is the one to use while you work.
